grammar.pattern: 光 / 仅 / 仅仅 / 就 / 至少
grammar.purpose: Read scope and minimum quantities accurately
grammar.explanation: 光带笔就行 means a pen alone suffices in this context; it does not claim pens are the only permitted object. 仅/仅仅 restrict scope. 就两个人 emphasizes a small exact count. 至少两个人 sets a minimum of two, allowing more. 至少提前一天 sets a minimum lead time, not exactly one day. Keep only, sufficiency and minimum distinct.

examples.py: jǐn shèng liǎng gè míng é .

examples.zh: 就两个人，不是至少两个人。
examples.py: jiù liǎng gè rén , bù shì zhì shǎo liǎng gè rén .
examples.en: Exactly two people, not at least two.

examples.py: zhì shǎo tí qián yī tiān bào míng .
examples.en: Sign up at least one day ahead.

commonMistakes.wrong: 至少两个就是只能两个。
commonMistakes.why: A minimum does not impose a maximum.

grammar.purpose: Describe plentiful supplies without claiming unlimited capacity
grammar.explanation: 材料有的是 / 有的是材料 says materials are plentiful. It does not give an exact number and does not transfer that abundance to seats, time or places. Distinguish the idiomatic plentiful construction from 有的材料…: some of the materials. In a practical notice, verify each resource separately.

commonMistakes.why: Abundance in one resource does not prove another is available.

lines.zh: 周四，陈宇问我要不要去看周六的演出。我想去，打开订票页面一看，只剩两个位子。我们一人一张，正好订完。
lines.py: zhōu sì , chén yǔ wèn wǒ yào bù yào qù kàn zhōu liù de yǎn chū . wǒ xiǎng qù , dǎ kāi dìng piào yè miàn yī kàn , zhǐ shèng liǎng gè wèi zi . wǒ men yī rén yī zhāng , zhèng hǎo dìng wán .
lines.en: On Thursday Chen Yu asked if I'd like to see Saturday's performance. The booking page showed just two seats. We booked one each and took the last two.

lines.zh: 票价是二十元，时间是晚上七点。地址在学校旁边的公共活动室，我把它存进手机，免得走到上次的地方。
lines.py: piào jià shì èr shí yuán , shí jiān shì wǎn shang qī diǎn . dì zhǐ zài xué xiào páng biān de gōng gòng huó dòng shì , wǒ bǎ tā cún jìn shǒu jī , miǎn de zǒu dào shàng cì de dì fāng .
lines.en: Tickets were twenty yuan and the show started at seven. I saved the address of the shared activity room by the school so I wouldn't go to the previous venue.

lines.zh: 周六六点半，我们在学校门口见面。陈宇穿了一件新衬衫，我问他是不是专门买的。他说不是，只是终于想起来穿。
lines.py: zhōu liù liù diǎn bàn , wǒ men zài xué xiào mén kǒu jiàn miàn . chén yǔ chuān le yī jiàn xīn chèn shān , wǒ wèn tā shì bú shì zhuān mén mǎi de . tā shuō bù shì , zhǐ shì zhōng yú xiǎng qǐ lái chuān .
lines.en: We met at the school entrance at six thirty on Saturday. Chen Yu had a new shirt. Had he bought it for this? No, he said; he'd finally remembered to wear it.

lines.zh: 走到活动室，门口的人看了票，让我们进去。前面两排已经坐满，我们的位子在第三排，离舞台也不远。
lines.py: zǒu dào huó dòng shì , mén kǒu de rén kàn le piào , ràng wǒ men jìn qù . qián miàn liǎng pái yǐ jīng zuò mǎn , wǒ men de wèi zi zài dì sān pái , lí wǔ tái yě bù yuǎn .
lines.en: At the activity room someone checked our tickets and let us in. The first two rows were full. Our seats were in the third row, still near the stage.

lines.zh: 演出开始以后，陈宇把手机放进包里。我也收起来，坐着听了一个多小时。最后一首歌，我们都听过，就轻轻跟着唱。
lines.py: yǎn chū kāi shǐ yǐ hòu , chén yǔ bǎ shǒu jī fàng jìn bāo lǐ . wǒ yě shōu qǐ lái , zuò zhe tīng le yī gè duō xiǎo shí . zuì hòu yī shǒu gē , wǒ men dōu tīng guò , jiù qīng qīng gēn zhe chàng .
lines.en: When the show began Chen Yu put his phone away. I did too, and we listened for over an hour. We both knew the last song and quietly sang along.

lines.zh: 结束时我问他，下次还来吗。他说来，不过至少早一点订，省得每次都只剩两个位子。
lines.py: jié shù shí wǒ wèn tā , xià cì hái lái ma . tā shuō lái , bù guò zhì shǎo zǎo yī diǎn dìng , shěng de měi cì dōu zhǐ shèng liǎng gè wèi zi .
lines.en: Afterwards I asked if he'd come again. Yes, he said, but let's at least book earlier, rather than always finding just two seats left.

lines.en: At least tell me when you'll be back.

lines.zh: 别急，周末有的是时间。
lines.py: bié jí , zhōu mò yǒu de shì shí jiān .
lines.en: Don't rush. We've got plenty of time at the weekend.

lines.zh: 冰箱里有的是吃的。
lines.py: bīng xiāng lǐ yǒu de shì chī de .
lines.en: There's plenty to eat in the fridge.

lines.zh: 目前还没有回家的车票。
lines.py: mù qián hái méi yǒu huí jiā de chē piào .
lines.en: There are no tickets home available at present.

lines.zh: 我目前住在学校附近。
lines.py: wǒ mù qián zhù zài xué xiào fù jìn .
lines.en: I'm currently living near the school.

lines.zh: 这家店近期要搬家。
lines.py: zhè jiā diàn jìn qī yào bān jiā .
lines.en: This shop is moving soon.

lines.zh: 她近期不在北京。
lines.py: tā jìn qī bù zài běi jīng .
lines.en: She hasn't been in Beijing recently.

lines.zh: 这个盒子是空的。
lines.py: zhè gè hé zi shì kōng de .
lines.en: This box is empty.

lines.zh: 桌上还有一个空杯子。
lines.py: zhuō shàng hái yǒu yī gè kōng bēi zi .
lines.en: There's another empty cup on the table.

lines.zh: 比赛结果明天公布。
lines.py: bǐ sài jié guǒ míng tiān gōng bù .
lines.en: The competition results will be announced tomorrow.

lines.zh: 学校公布了放假时间。
lines.py: xué xiào gōng bù le fàng jià shí jiān .
lines.en: The school announced the holiday dates.

lines.zh: 这里规定十点以后不能唱歌。
lines.py: zhè lǐ guī dìng shí diǎn yǐ hòu bù néng chàng gē .
lines.en: The rules here prohibit singing after ten.

lines.zh: 他给自己规定每天读十页。
lines.py: tā gěi zì jǐ guī dìng měi tiān dú shí yè .
lines.en: He set himself a rule of reading ten pages a day.

lines.zh: 我保证这次不迟到。
lines.py: wǒ bǎo zhèng zhè cì bù chí dào .
lines.en: I promise I won't be late this time.

lines.zh: 这个袋子能保证书不淋湿吗？
lines.py: zhè gè dài zi néng bǎo zhèng shū bù lín shī ma ?
lines.en: Will this bag keep the books dry in the rain?

lines.zh: 你确定是在这个门口等吗？
lines.py: nǐ què dìng shì zài zhè gè mén kǒu děng ma ?
lines.en: Are you sure we're waiting at this entrance?

lines.zh: 日期确定以后，发消息给我。
lines.py: rì qī què dìng yǐ hòu , fā xiāo xī gěi wǒ .
lines.en: Message me once the date is confirmed.

lines.zh: 周末的票价比平时高。
lines.py: zhōu mò de piào jià bǐ píng shí gāo .
lines.en: Tickets cost more at weekends.

lines.zh: 儿童票价是多少？
lines.py: ér tóng piào jià shì duō shao ?
lines.en: How much is a child's ticket?

lines.zh: 这次旅行的费用我们平分。
lines.py: zhè cì lǚ xíng de fèi yòng wǒ men píng fēn .
lines.en: We'll split the cost of this trip.

lines.zh: 换电池的费用包括在里面吗？
lines.py: huàn diàn chí de fèi yòng bāo kuò zài lǐ miàn ma ?
lines.en: Does that include the cost of replacing the battery?

lines.zh: 这件衣服的价格有点高。
lines.py: zhè jiàn yī fú de jià gé yǒu diǎn gāo .
lines.en: This garment's price is a little high.

lines.zh: 我想比较一下两家店的价格。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng bǐ jiào yī xià liǎng jiā diàn de jià gé .
lines.en: I'd like to compare prices at the two shops.

lines.zh: 这个包是什么价钱？
lines.py: zhè gè bāo shì shén me jià qián ?
lines.en: How much is this bag?

lines.zh: 价钱差不多，我选蓝色的。
lines.py: jià qián chà bu duō , wǒ xuǎn lán sè de .
lines.en: The prices are similar, so I'll choose the blue one.

lines.zh: 有必要提前订位子吗？
lines.py: yǒu bì yào tí qián dìng wèi zi ma ?
lines.en: Do we need to book seats in advance?

lines.zh: 没必要为这点小事生气。
lines.py: méi bì yào wèi zhè diǎn xiǎo shì shēng qì .
lines.en: There's no need to get angry over such a small thing.

lines.zh: 附近有没有适合聊天的场所？
lines.py: fù jìn yǒu méi yǒu shì hé liáo tiān de chǎng suǒ ?
lines.en: Is there somewhere nearby that's suitable for a chat?

lines.zh: 这个场所晚上八点关门。
lines.py: zhè gè chǎng suǒ wǎn shang bā diǎn guān mén .
lines.en: This venue closes at eight in the evening.

lines.zh: 这种场合穿衬衫比较合适。
lines.py: zhè zhǒng chǎng hé chuān chèn shān bǐ jiào hé shì .
lines.en: A shirt would be appropriate for this occasion.

lines.zh: 我在不同的场合见过她两次。
lines.py: wǒ zài bù tóng de chǎng hé jiàn guò tā liǎng cì .
lines.en: I've met her twice on different occasions.

lines.zh: 请别把包放在公共通道里。
lines.py: qǐng bié bǎ bāo fàng zài gōng gòng tōng dào lǐ .
lines.en: Please don't leave your bag in the shared passageway.

lines.zh: 这里的公共交通很方便。
lines.py: zhè lǐ de gōng gòng jiāo tōng hěn fāng biàn .
lines.en: Public transport is convenient here.

lines.zh: 这张优惠券今天还有效。
lines.py: zhè zhāng yōu huì quàn jīn tiān hái yǒu xiào .
lines.en: This voucher is still valid today.

lines.zh: 换一种办法可能更有效。
lines.py: huàn yī zhǒng bàn fǎ kě néng gèng yǒu xiào .
lines.en: A different approach might work better.

lines.zh: 下雨了，野餐取消吧。
lines.py: xià yǔ le , yě cān qǔ xiāo ba .
lines.en: It's raining. Let's cancel the picnic.

lines.zh: 我取消了明天的订位。
lines.py: wǒ qǔ xiāo le míng tiān de dìng wèi .
lines.en: I cancelled tomorrow's reservation.

audio.zh: 七点。票上写仅限当天使用。

audio.py: jié shù shí wǒ wèn tā , xià cì hái lái ma . tā shuō lái , bù guò zhì shǎo zǎo yī diǎn dìng , shěng de měi cì dōu zhǐ shèng liǎng gè wèi zi .
audio.en: Afterwards I asked if he'd come again. Yes, he said, but let's at least book earlier, rather than always finding just two seats left.
